description: ESLint plugins for JavaScript and TypeScript security: rules for Node.js, Express, NestJS, browser code, JWT, PostgreSQL, MongoDB and other database drivers, MCP servers and AI SDKs. Flat config for ESLint 9 and 10, designed to run alongside eslint-plugin-security. Each package documents its presets and rules.
rules: Use ESLint flat config (eslint.config.mjs). Each preset, such as configs.recommended, is one config object: put it in the exported array as an element and do not spread it.
Keep eslint-plugin-security if the project already uses it, and add the Interlace plugin for each library listed in package.json next to it. The plugins complement each other.
Database, framework and SDK plugins only report in files that import that library, so check a new setup against a file that imports it.
Some plugins skip files under test, fixtures or mocks directories, so check a new setup against a file outside them.
